description: This Java interface defines callbacks for handling download operations, including progress updates, completion notification, and network status retrieval within an Android application.

classes.name: DownloadCallback
classes.description: Interface providing callback methods for download progress, completion, and network status.

classes.name: DownloadCallback.Progress
classes.description: Inner interface containing constants representing progress states of a download.

methods.name: updateFromDownload
methods.description: Updates the UI with the result of the download operation.

methods.name: getActiveNetworkInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the current active network information.

methods.name: onProgressUpdate
methods.description: Indicates progress updates during the download process.

methods.name: finishDownloading
methods.description: Signals that the download operation has finished.
